content:
Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (BCECEB) has released the Revised Second Round Seat Allotment Result of DCECE [PE]-2026 (Polytechnic Engineering).

The earlier Round 2 provisional allotment (around mid–late July 2026) was revised. The board notice states: Revised Second Round Seat Allotment result of DCECE[PE]-2026 is now available on the official website.

What candidates should do

  • Login on bceceboard.bihar.gov.in and check the revised Round 2 allotment status
  • Download the Allotment Order only after the revised result
  • Check Opening & Closing Rank / cutoff PDF for Round 2 if published
  • Complete document verification and admission formalities within the dates notified by BCECEB (document verification reported from 27 July 2026)

How to check revised allotment

  1. Open https://bceceboard.bihar.gov.in
  2. Click the link for Revised Second Round Seat Allotment – DCECE [PE]-2026
  3. Login with credentials used in counselling
  4. View allotted polytechnic and branch; download allotment letter

Candidates who did not get a seat or wish to upgrade may wait for further rounds if announced by the board. Always follow only official BCECEB notices for DV centres, fees and last dates.
